en_US: Use to cast. When the bobber is pulled under with a splash, use again within about 2 seconds to set the hook.

Small fish come in at once. Bigger fish fight: while the fish thrashes (bobber dragged under, heavy splashing, line taut) wait; when it rests (bobber floats, line slack) use the rod to reel it closer. Reeling while it thrashes strains the line and can snap it.
Bait in your inventory is used automatically: Caterpillar (faster bites), Shrimp (bigger fish), Fish Meal Bait (fastest bites), Glow Bait (deep-water night fish).
What bites depends on the water: biome, depth, time of day and rain.

Fish schools: where you see fine splashes, fish leaping out of the water and seagulls circling overhead, cast into the middle. Bites come much sooner, rarer fish come up and there is no junk. A school drifts and breaks up after a few minutes.
Every fish you land is small (◆), medium (◆◆) or large (◆◆◆). Don't leave fish lying on the beach: seagulls steal them.
zh_TW: 使用即可拋竿。浮標被拖入水中並濺起水花時，約 2 秒內再使用一次即可上鉤。
小魚會直接被拉上來。大魚會掙扎：魚在拉扯時（浮標被拖下水、水花四濺、釣線繃緊）先等待；魚在喘息時（浮標浮起、釣線放鬆）使用釣竿把牠拉近。拉扯時硬收會讓釣線吃力，太多次會斷線。
背包中的餌會自動使用：毛毛蟲（咬鉤較快）、蝦（較易釣到大魚）、魚粉餌（咬鉤最快）、發光餌（夜行深海魚）。
上鉤的魚取決於水域：生物群系、水深、時段與下雨。
魚群：看到細碎水花、有魚跳出水面、海鷗在上空盤旋的地方，往中間拋竿。咬鉤快很多、較容易釣到少見的魚，也不會釣到垃圾。魚群會慢慢移動，幾分鐘後散去。
釣上來的魚分小（◆）、中（◆◆）、大（◆◆◆）。別把魚丟在沙灘上，海鷗會叼走。
zh_CN: 使用即可抛竿。浮标被拖入水中并溅起水花时，约 2 秒内再使用一次即可上钩。
小鱼会直接被拉上来。大鱼会挣扎：鱼在拉扯时（浮标被拖下水、水花四溅、钓线绷紧）先等待；鱼在喘息时（浮标浮起、钓线放松）使用钓竿把它拉近。拉扯时硬收会让钓线吃力，太多次会断线。
背包中的饵会自动使用：毛毛虫（咬钩较快）、虾（较易钓到大鱼）、鱼粉饵（咬钩最快）、发光饵（夜行深海鱼）。
上钩的鱼取决于水域：生物群系、水深、时段与下雨。
鱼群：看到细碎水花、有鱼跳出水面、海鸥在上空盘旋的地方，往中间抛竿。咬钩快很多、较容易钓到少见的鱼，也不会钓到垃圾。鱼群会慢慢移动，几分钟后散去。
钓上来的鱼分小（◆）、中（◆◆）、大（◆◆◆）。别把鱼丢在沙滩上，海鸥会叼走。

Only this rod can hook an Anglerfish.

只有這支釣竿釣得到鮟鱇魚。

mechanics: Works like the Bamboo Fishing Rod, but fish bite sooner, the line holds more strain, each reel pulls further, and large fish are more likely.

zh_TW: 漁歌釣竿在鍛造台用獄髓升級而成。在水裡用法同漁歌釣竿，也能在岩漿裡釣魚：往下界的岩漿湖拋竿。岩漿裡的漁獲一拉上來就是熟的。可以附上和一般釣竿相同的魔咒。

en_US: Place it in water (it can sit underwater). Use it with bait: Caterpillar, Rotten Flesh, raw Cod or Salmon, White Fish Fillet or Dried Fish.
Over time shrimp and crabs crawl in; you can see them through the bamboo. Use it with an empty hand to take them out.
Fresh water mostly brings shrimp; seas, beaches and swamps bring crabs too. Bait can be used up.

過一段時間蝦蟹會鑽進籠子，可以從竹條縫隙看到。空手使用即可取出。
淡水多半是蝦；海洋、海灘與沼澤也會有螃蟹。餌會被吃掉。
zh_CN: 放进水里（可以整个沉在水中）。手持饵使用它即可放饵：毛毛虫、腐肉、生鳕鱼或生鲑鱼、白肉鱼片、鱼干。
过一段时间虾蟹会钻进笼子，可以从竹条缝隙看到。空手使用即可取出。
淡水多半是虾；海洋、海滩与沼泽也会有螃蟹。饵会被吃掉。

打破纪录的鱼会带有 ★ 与体长。

en_US: Hold it and look down at the dial. The hand goes round once every tide: while it points at the blue arc on the far rim the tide is high, anywhere else it is low.
The small moon near the low mark shows tonight's moon phase.
It only moves while you hold it: in the inventory or in an Item Frame the picture stays still.
zh_TW: 拿在手上低頭看盤面。指針每一次潮汐轉一圈：指著遠端的藍色弧段時是漲潮，其他位置是退潮。
靠近退潮記號的小月亮顯示今晚的月相。
只有拿在手上時才會動：在物品欄或物品展示框裡圖案是靜止的。
zh_CN: 拿在手上低头看盘面。指针每一次潮汐转一圈：指着远端的蓝色弧段时是涨潮，其他位置是退潮。
靠近退潮记号的小月亮显示今晚的月相。
只有拿在手上时才会动：在物品栏或物品展示框里图案是静止的。

mechanics: Hold it and look down at the dial. The hand goes round once every tide: while it points at the blue arc on the far rim the tide is high, anywhere else it is low.
The small moon near the low mark shows tonight's moon phase.
It only moves while you hold it: in the inventory or in an Item Frame the picture stays still.

en_US: Wear it while fishing: shaded and patient, fish bite sooner.
zh_TW: 釣魚時戴著：遮陽又沉得住氣，魚更快上鉤。
zh_CN: 钓鱼时戴着：遮阳又沉得住气，鱼更快上钩。

mechanics: Wear it while fishing: shaded and patient, fish bite sooner.

en_US: Wear it while fishing: you stand steadier, so the line takes more strain before it snaps. In the rain, fish bite even sooner.
zh_TW: 釣魚時穿著：站得更穩，線比較耐拉、不容易斷。下雨時魚上鉤更快。
zh_CN: 钓鱼时穿着：站得更稳，线比较耐拉、不容易断。下雨时鱼上钩更快。

mechanics: Wear it while fishing: you stand steadier, so the line takes more strain before it snaps. In the rain, fish bite even sooner.

en_US: Grows on beaches by the water. Break it for 1-3 Oysters; with Silk Touch you keep the whole bed and can place it again.
zh_TW: 長在海灘水邊。打掉可得 1～3 個牡蠣；用絲綢之觸可以整塊帶走，再放回去。
zh_CN: 长在海滩水边。打掉可得 1～3 个牡蛎；用精准采集可以整块带走，再放回去。

mechanics: Grows on beaches by the water. Break it for 1-3 Oysters; with Silk Touch you keep the whole bed and can place it again.

en_US: Rivers, swamps and lakes at night, more in the rain. Fish Meal Bait helps.
zh_TW: 河流、沼澤、湖泊的夜晚，下雨更多。魚粉餌有幫助。
zh_CN: 河流、沼泽、湖泊的夜晚，下雨更多。鱼粉饵有帮助。

mechanics: Rivers, swamps and lakes at night, more in the rain. Fish Meal Bait helps.

en_US: Cold and temperate seas at night. Glow Bait helps.
zh_TW: 寒冷與溫和海域的夜晚。發光餌有幫助。
zh_CN: 寒冷与温和海域的夜晚。发光饵有帮助。

mechanics: Cold and temperate seas at night. Glow Bait helps.

en_US: Kill a Squid or Glow Squid with a knife (the Fishing Knife or any Cookery kitchen knife).
zh_TW: 用刀（漁刀或森羅的任何菜刀）擊殺魷魚或發光魷魚取得。
zh_CN: 用刀（渔刀或森罗的任何菜刀）击杀鱿鱼或发光鱿鱼取得。

mechanics: Kill a Squid or Glow Squid with a knife (the Fishing Knife or any Cookery kitchen knife).

en_US: Break a Laver Rock on the shore. Dry it on a Bamboo Tray to make Nori.
zh_TW: 打掉海岸邊的紫菜礁取得。放在竹匾曬乾就是海苔。
zh_CN: 打掉海岸边的紫菜礁取得。放在竹匾晒干就是海苔。

mechanics: Break a Laver Rock on the shore. Dry it on a Bamboo Tray to make Nori.

en_US: Grows on beaches and stony shores. Break it for 1-3 Laver; Silk Touch keeps the rock.
zh_TW: 長在海灘與石岸。打掉可得 1～3 片紫菜；絲綢之觸可整塊帶走。
zh_CN: 长在海滩与石岸。打掉可得 1～3 片紫菜；精准采集可整块带走。

mechanics: Grows on beaches and stony shores. Break it for 1-3 Laver; Silk Touch keeps the rock.

en_US: Roast Fish Bones in a furnace, smoker or campfire, or crush Dried Fish in a crafting grid (2 each). Makes Fish Meal Bait, or 2 Bone Meal.
zh_TW: 把魚骨放進熔爐、煙燻爐或營火烤，或在工作台把魚乾壓碎（一條得 2 份）。可做魚粉餌，也能換 2 個骨粉。
zh_CN: 把鱼骨放进熔炉、烟熏炉或营火烤，或在工作台把鱼干压碎（一条得 2 份）。可做鱼粉饵，也能换 2 个骨粉。

mechanics: Roast Fish Bones in a furnace, smoker or campfire, or crush Dried Fish in a crafting grid (2 each). Makes Fish Meal Bait, or 2 Bone Meal.

en_US: From the Fish Cleaning Board. Simmer 3 in the Stockpot to make Fish Scale Jelly.
zh_TW: 魚案板去鱗得到。3 份放進湯鍋熬成魚鱗凍。
zh_CN: 鱼案板去鳞得到。3 份放进汤锅熬成鱼鳞冻。

mechanics: From the Fish Cleaning Board. Simmer 3 in the Stockpot to make Fish Scale Jelly.

en_US: From the Fish Cleaning Board. Good bait: keep it in your inventory while fishing, or put it in a Shrimp Trap.
zh_TW: 魚案板剖腹得到。很好的餌：釣魚時放在背包，或放進蝦籠。
zh_CN: 鱼案板剖腹得到。很好的饵：钓鱼时放在背包，或放进虾笼。

mechanics: From the Fish Cleaning Board. Good bait: keep it in your inventory while fishing, or put it in a Shrimp Trap.

en_US: From the Fish Cleaning Board. Roast into Fish Meal, or boil into Fish Stock.
zh_TW: 魚案板切片後得到。烤成魚粉，或熬成魚高湯。
zh_CN: 鱼案板切片后得到。烤成鱼粉，或熬成鱼高汤。

mechanics: From the Fish Cleaning Board. Roast into Fish Meal, or boil into Fish Stock.

en_US: Sometimes found when gutting carp, croaker, mackerel, sea bream, cod, saury and especially salmon.
zh_TW: 剖鯉魚、小黃魚、鯖魚、真鯛、鱈魚、秋刀魚時偶爾會有，鮭魚最常見。
zh_CN: 剖鲤鱼、小黄鱼、鲭鱼、真鲷、鳕鱼、秋刀鱼时偶尔会有，鲑鱼最常见。

mechanics: Sometimes found when gutting carp, croaker, mackerel, sea bream, cod, saury and especially salmon.

en_US: Brew Dried Kelp in Cookery's teapot. Can be placed and stacked like Cookery's teas.
zh_TW: 把乾海帶放進森羅的茶壺沖泡。可以像本體的茶一樣擺放堆疊。
zh_CN: 把干海带放进森罗的茶壶冲泡。可以像本体的茶一样摆放堆叠。

mechanics: Brew Dried Kelp in Cookery's teapot. Can be placed and stacked like Cookery's teas.

en_US: A kitchen knife for the Chopping Board, and the tool for getting Squid. A decent weapon too.
zh_TW: 可在砧板使用的刀，也是取得魷魚的工具，拿來防身也不錯。
zh_CN: 可在砧板使用的刀，也是取得鱿鱼的工具，拿来防身也不错。

mechanics: A kitchen knife for the Chopping Board, and the tool for getting Squid. A decent weapon too.

en_US: While it is in your inventory, fish you land go into the creel instead of your pockets (up to 256). Use it to take them out.
zh_TW: 放在背包時，釣到的魚會直接進魚簍，不佔背包（最多 256 條）。使用魚簍即可取出。
zh_CN: 放在背包时，钓到的鱼会直接进鱼篓，不占背包（最多 256 条）。使用鱼篓即可取出。

mechanics: While it is in your inventory, fish you land go into the creel instead of your pockets (up to 256). Use it to take them out.

en_US: Bait. Keep it in your inventory while fishing: bites come much sooner, and eels like it.
zh_TW: 餌。釣魚時放在背包：魚上鉤快很多，鰻魚特別喜歡。
zh_CN: 饵。钓鱼时放在背包：鱼上钩快很多，鳗鱼特别喜欢。

mechanics: Bait. Keep it in your inventory while fishing: bites come much sooner, and eels like it.

en_US: Bait that glows in deep water. Night fish (anglerfish, hairtail, saury, octopus) come to it far more often.
zh_TW: 在深水發光的餌。夜行的魚（鮟鱇、白帶魚、秋刀魚、章魚）更容易上鉤。
zh_CN: 在深水发光的饵。夜行的鱼（鮟鱇、带鱼、秋刀鱼、章鱼）更容易上钩。

mechanics: Bait that glows in deep water. Night fish (anglerfish, hairtail, saury, octopus) come to it far more often.

en_US: Found in fishermen's huts. Read it to learn a recipe; learned recipes are listed in the Angler's Journal.
zh_TW: 在漁屋裡找到。閱讀後學會一道料理，學會的料理會記在漁歌手帳裡。
zh_CN: 在渔屋里找到。阅读后学会一道料理，学会的料理会记在渔歌手帐里。

mechanics: Found in fishermen's huts. Read it to learn a recipe; learned recipes are listed in the Angler's Journal.

en_US: Put a whole fish on it, then work it with a knife (Fishing Knife or any Cookery kitchen knife): first scale it, then gut it, then fillet it. You get more fillets than on the Chopping Board, plus scales, offal, bones and sometimes roe. Every fish works. Eels, catfish, hairtail, saury, anglerfish, octopus and pufferfish have no scales to remove; gutting an octopus may give an Ink Sac, and gutting a pufferfish removes its poison. A large fish (◆◆◆) gives one more fillet and a small one (◆) one less. Before the first cut you can take the fish back with an empty hand.
zh_TW: 把整條魚放上去，用刀（漁刀或森羅任何菜刀）依序處理：去鱗、剖腹去內臟、切片。比砧板多出魚片，還會得到魚鱗、魚雜、魚骨，有時有魚卵。所有魚都能處理。鰻魚、鯰魚、白帶魚、秋刀魚、鮟鱇、章魚、河豚沒有鱗，直接剖腹；章魚剖腹可能得到墨囊，河豚剖腹會去掉毒。大魚（◆◆◆）多切一份，小魚（◆）少一份。還沒下刀前可以空手把魚拿回來。
zh_CN: 把整条鱼放上去，用刀（渔刀或森罗任何菜刀）依序处理：去鳞、剖腹去内脏、切片。比砧板多出鱼片，还会得到鱼鳞、鱼杂、鱼骨，有时有鱼卵。所有鱼都能处理。鳗鱼、鲇鱼、带鱼、秋刀鱼、鮟鱇、章鱼、河豚没有鳞，直接剖腹；章鱼剖腹可能得到墨囊，河豚剖腹会去掉毒。大鱼（◆◆◆）多切一份，小鱼（◆）少一份。还没下刀前可以空手把鱼拿回来。

mechanics: Put a whole fish on it, then work it with a knife (Fishing Knife or any Cookery kitchen knife): first scale it, then gut it, then fillet it. You get more fillets than on the Chopping Board, plus scales, offal, bones and sometimes roe. Every fish works. Eels, catfish, hairtail, saury, anglerfish, octopus and pufferfish have no scales to remove; gutting an octopus may give an Ink Sac, and gutting a pufferfish removes its poison. A large fish (◆◆◆) gives one more fillet and a small one (◆) one less. Before the first cut you can take the fish back with an empty hand.

en_US: Use a fish on it and the needle shows its size: every fish you reel in is small, medium or large (◆, ◆◆ or ◆◆◆ under its name). A record fish (★ and its length) is weighed exactly and sparkles.
zh_TW: 拿魚對它使用，指針會指出牠的大小：自己釣上來的魚分小、中、大（名稱下方的 ◆、◆◆、◆◆◆）。紀錄魚（★ 加長度）會秤出準確的位置並閃光。
zh_CN: 拿鱼对它使用，指针会指出它的大小：自己钓上来的鱼分小、中、大（名称下方的 ◆、◆◆、◆◆◆）。纪录鱼（★ 加长度）会称出准确的位置并闪光。

mechanics: Use a fish on it and the needle shows its size: every fish you reel in is small, medium or large (◆, ◆◆ or ◆◆◆ under its name). A record fish (★ and its length) is weighed exactly and sparkles.

en_US: A bamboo-and-paper lantern. Hang it under a block or stand it on the ground.
zh_TW: 竹骨紙燈。可以掛在方塊下方，也可以立在地上。
zh_CN: 竹骨纸灯。可以挂在方块下方，也可以立在地上。

mechanics: A bamboo-and-paper lantern. Hang it under a block or stand it on the ground.

en_US: Hang a fishing rod on it to keep it (the rod keeps its wear and enchantments). Use it with an empty hand to take the rod back.

Tackle parts: use a hook, line or bobber on the rack to fit it to the rod hung there last (a part already in that slot comes back to you). Shears take all parts off that rod. Parts stay on the rod wherever you take it; a fitted bobber and line show their colours when you fish.
Any of our rods hangs here, the Lava rod too. Use an Eye of Ender on a hung Voyage Fishing Rod to turn it into an Ender Fishing Rod (it keeps its wear, enchantments and parts).
zh_TW: 拿釣竿對它使用就能掛上去（耐久與附魔不變）。空手使用取回。
釣具部件：拿鉤、線或浮標對漁具架使用，就會裝到最後掛上去的那支釣竿（同一格原本的部件會還給你）。用剪刀可拆下那支釣竿的全部部件。部件會一直留在釣竿上；釣魚時看得到裝上的浮標與釣線顏色。
我們的釣竿都掛得上去，熔岩釣竿也可以。拿末影之眼對掛著的漁歌釣竿使用，它會變成末影釣竿（耐久、附魔和部件都保留）。
zh_CN: 拿钓竿对它使用就能挂上去（耐久与附魔不变）。空手使用取回。
钓具部件：拿钩、线或浮标对渔具架使用，就会装到最后挂上去的那支钓竿（同一格原本的部件会还给你）。用剪刀可拆下那支钓竿的全部部件。部件会一直留在钓竿上；钓鱼时看得到装上的浮标与钓线颜色。
我们的钓竿都挂得上去，熔岩钓竿也可以。拿末影之眼对挂着的渔歌钓竿使用，它会变成末影钓竿（耐久、附魔和部件都保留）。

mechanics: Hang a fishing rod on it to keep it (the rod keeps its wear and enchantments). Use it with an empty hand to take the rod back.

Tackle parts: use a hook, line or bobber on the rack to fit it to the rod hung there last (a part already in that slot comes back to you). Shears take all parts off that rod. Parts stay on the rod wherever you take it; a fitted bobber and line show their colours when you fish.
Any of our rods hangs here, the Lava rod too. Use an Eye of Ender on a hung Voyage Fishing Rod to turn it into an Ender Fishing Rod (it keeps its wear, enchantments and parts).

en_US: Put any fish in it (octopus, pufferfish, jellyfish and crabs too) and it swims to and fro behind the glass. Use it with an empty hand to take the fish back. Two Fish Tanks make a Large Fish Tank.
zh_TW: 任何魚都能放進去（章魚、河豚、水母、螃蟹也可以），牠會在玻璃後面游來游去。空手使用取回。兩個魚缸可以合成一個大魚缸。
zh_CN: 任何鱼都能放进去（章鱼、河豚、水母、螃蟹也可以），它会在玻璃后面游来游去。空手使用取回。两个鱼缸可以合成一个大鱼缸。

mechanics: Put any fish in it (octopus, pufferfish, jellyfish and crabs too) and it swims to and fro behind the glass. Use it with an empty hand to take the fish back. Two Fish Tanks make a Large Fish Tank.

en_US: Two blocks wide, it holds up to four fish, and they all swim the length of the tank. Use a fish on it to add one; use it with an empty hand to take the newest one out. Breaking it gives back the tank and every fish.
zh_TW: 兩格寬，最多放四條魚，牠們會在整個缸裡游來游去。拿魚對它使用就放進去，空手使用取出最後放進去的那條。打掉時魚缸和所有魚都會還給你。
zh_CN: 两格宽，最多放四条鱼，它们会在整个缸里游来游去。拿鱼对它使用就放进去，空手使用取出最后放进去的那条。打掉时鱼缸和所有鱼都会还给你。

mechanics: Two blocks wide, it holds up to four fish, and they all swim the length of the tank. Use a fish on it to add one; use it with an empty hand to take the newest one out. Breaking it gives back the tank and every fish.

en_US: A net with cork floats, for decoration.
zh_TW: 掛著浮子的漁網，裝飾用。
zh_CN: 挂着浮子的渔网，装饰用。

mechanics: A net with cork floats, for decoration.

en_US: Gyotaku. Hang the blank frame on a wall, then use any fish on it: the fish is inked onto the paper (you keep the fish). The frame shows how big it was: bronze for small, silver for medium, gold for large, and gold with a red seal for a record fish. Breaking it gives the blank frame back.
zh_TW: 魚拓。把空白畫框掛在牆上，再拿任何魚對它使用，魚的樣子就印在紙上（魚還給你）。畫框看得出魚有多大：小魚銅框、中魚銀框、大魚金框，紀錄魚是金框加紅色印章。打掉會拿回空白畫框。
zh_CN: 鱼拓。把空白画框挂在墙上，再拿任何鱼对它使用，鱼的样子就印在纸上（鱼还给你）。画框看得出鱼有多大：小鱼铜框、中鱼银框、大鱼金框，纪录鱼是金框加红色印章。打掉会拿回空白画框。

mechanics: Gyotaku. Hang the blank frame on a wall, then use any fish on it: the fish is inked onto the paper (you keep the fish). The frame shows how big it was: bronze for small, silver for medium, gold for large, and gold with a red seal for a record fish. Breaking it gives the blank frame back.

en_US: Cormorants live by rivers and in mangrove swamps. Tame one with raw carp, sweetfish, mackerel, yellow croaker, saury, cod or salmon; it then follows you. Put this ring on a tamed cormorant: near water it dives every half minute or so and brings you a small fish (into your Fish Creel if you carry one). Without the ring it eats what it catches. Shears take the ring off.
zh_TW: 鸕鶿住在河邊和紅樹林沼澤。用生的鯉魚、香魚、鯖魚、小黃魚、秋刀魚、鱈魚或鮭魚馴服後，牠會跟著你。把頸環戴在馴服的鸕鶿身上，牠在水邊大約每半分鐘會潛水一次，叼一條小魚回來給你（有魚簍就直接放進魚簍）。沒戴頸環的話，抓到的魚牠會自己吃掉。用剪刀可以取下頸環。
zh_CN: 鸬鹚住在河边和红树林沼泽。用生的鲤鱼、香鱼、鲭鱼、小黄鱼、秋刀鱼、鳕鱼或鲑鱼驯服后，它会跟着你。把颈环戴在驯服的鸬鹚身上，它在水边大约每半分钟会潜水一次，叼一条小鱼回来给你（有鱼篓就直接放进鱼篓）。没戴颈环的话，抓到的鱼它会自己吃掉。用剪刀可以取下颈环。

mechanics: Cormorants live by rivers and in mangrove swamps. Tame one with raw carp, sweetfish, mackerel, yellow croaker, saury, cod or salmon; it then follows you. Put this ring on a tamed cormorant: near water it dives every half minute or so and brings you a small fish (into your Fish Creel if you carry one). Without the ring it eats what it catches. Shears take the ring off.

en_US: Tackle part (hook). Less common fish bite more often (x1.25).
zh_TW: 釣具部件（鉤）。少見的魚更常上鉤（×1.25）。
zh_CN: 钓具部件（钩）。少见的鱼更常上钩（×1.25）。

mechanics: Tackle part (hook). Less common fish bite more often (x1.25).

en_US: Tackle part (hook). Less common fish bite far more often (x1.5), but gold is soft: the rod wears one more point per catch.
zh_TW: 釣具部件（鉤）。少見的魚上鉤多很多（×1.5），但金子軟，每釣一條釣竿多磨損 1 點。
zh_CN: 钓具部件（钩）。少见的鱼上钩多很多（×1.5），但金子软，每钓一条钓竿多磨损 1 点。

mechanics: Tackle part (hook). Less common fish bite far more often (x1.5), but gold is soft: the rod wears one more point per catch.

en_US: Tackle part (hook). Big fish take it: more of your catches are large (◆◆◆).
zh_TW: 釣具部件（鉤）。大魚愛咬：釣到大型魚（◆◆◆）的機會更高。
zh_CN: 钓具部件（钩）。大鱼爱咬：钓到大型鱼（◆◆◆）的机会更高。

mechanics: Tackle part (hook). Big fish take it: more of your catches are large (◆◆◆).

en_US: Tackle part (line). Tan line; takes one more strain before it snaps.
zh_TW: 釣具部件（線）。黃褐色釣線，多撐一次拉扯才會斷。
zh_CN: 钓具部件（线）。黄褐色钓线，多撑一次拉扯才会断。

mechanics: Tackle part (line). Tan line; takes one more strain before it snaps.

en_US: Tackle part (line). Grey steel line; takes two more strains, but fish see it and bite a little later.
zh_TW: 釣具部件（線）。灰色鋼絲線，多撐兩次拉扯，但魚看得到線，咬鉤稍慢。
zh_CN: 钓具部件（线）。灰色钢丝线，多撑两次拉扯，但鱼看得到线，咬钩稍慢。

mechanics: Tackle part (line). Grey steel line; takes two more strains, but fish see it and bite a little later.

en_US: Tackle part (line). Almost invisible: fish bite sooner, but it snaps one strain earlier.
zh_TW: 釣具部件（線）。幾乎看不見：魚咬鉤更快，但少撐一次拉扯。
zh_CN: 钓具部件（线）。几乎看不见：鱼咬钩更快，但少撑一次拉扯。

mechanics: Tackle part (line). Almost invisible: fish bite sooner, but it snaps one strain earlier.

en_US: Tackle part (bobber). Green bamboo float: bites come a little sooner and you have longer to set the hook.
zh_TW: 釣具部件（浮標）。綠色竹節浮標：咬鉤稍快，上鉤的反應時間也更長。
zh_CN: 钓具部件（浮标）。绿色竹节浮标：咬钩稍快，上钩的反应时间也更长。

mechanics: Tackle part (bobber). Green bamboo float: bites come a little sooner and you have longer to set the hook.

en_US: Tackle part (bobber). Glows teal on the water; at night bites come much sooner.
zh_TW: 釣具部件（浮標）。在水面發出青光；夜晚咬鉤快很多。
zh_CN: 钓具部件（浮标）。在水面发出青光；夜晚咬钩快很多。

mechanics: Tackle part (bobber). Glows teal on the water; at night bites come much sooner.

en_US: Tackle part (bobber). Grey weighted float that sinks the bait deeper: counts as 6 blocks deeper, so deep-water fish (tuna, hairtail, anglerfish) bite in shallower water.
zh_TW: 釣具部件（浮標）。灰色重墜浮標，把餌沉得更深：水深算多 6 格，較淺的水也釣得到深海魚（鮪魚、白帶魚、鮟鱇）。
zh_CN: 钓具部件（浮标）。灰色重坠浮标，把饵沉得更深：水深算多 6 格，较浅的水也钓得到深海鱼（金枪鱼、带鱼、鮟鱇）。

mechanics: Tackle part (bobber). Grey weighted float that sinks the bait deeper: counts as 6 blocks deeper, so deep-water fish (tuna, hairtail, anglerfish) bite in shallower water.

en_US: Open seas by day, often in schools. Dry it on a Drying Rack for katsuobushi.
zh_TW: 白天的開闊海域，常成群出現。掛上曬魚架可以做成柴魚。
zh_CN: 白天的开阔海域，常成群出现。挂上晒鱼架可以做成柴鱼。

mechanics: Open seas by day, often in schools. Dry it on a Drying Rack for katsuobushi.

en_US: Hang up to 3 of one kind: whole fish, squid or skipjack. Fish and squid dry in 2 days, skipjack in 3; you can see them darken. Rub Salt on fresh fish for Salted Fish. Rain on an open rack stops the drying, and gulls may take a fish when nobody is near. Use it with an empty hand to take one back, or everything once dry.
zh_TW: 一架掛一種，最多 3 條：整條魚、魷魚或鰹魚。魚和魷魚 2 天曬好，鰹魚要 3 天，看得到顏色慢慢變深。剛掛上的魚拿鹽抹一下就會曬成鹹魚。下雨時沒遮蔽的曬架會停下來，沒人在旁邊時海鷗可能來叼走一條。空手使用可取回一條；曬好後一次全部收下。
zh_CN: 一架挂一种，最多 3 条：整条鱼、鱿鱼或鲣鱼。鱼和鱿鱼 2 天晒好，鲣鱼要 3 天，看得到颜色慢慢变深。刚挂上的鱼拿盐抹一下就会晒成咸鱼。下雨时没遮蔽的晒架会停下来，没人在旁边时海鸥可能来叼走一条。空手使用可取回一条；晒好后一次全部收下。

mechanics: Hang up to 3 of one kind: whole fish, squid or skipjack. Fish and squid dry in 2 days, skipjack in 3; you can see them darken. Rub Salt on fresh fish for Salted Fish. Rain on an open rack stops the drying, and gulls may take a fish when nobody is near. Use it with an empty hand to take one back, or everything once dry.

en_US: Whole fish dried for 2 days on a Drying Rack. Keeps well and is good to eat as it is.
zh_TW: 整條魚在曬魚架上曬 2 天。耐放，直接吃也不錯。
zh_CN: 整条鱼在晒鱼架上晒 2 天。耐放，直接吃也不错。

mechanics: Whole fish dried for 2 days on a Drying Rack. Keeps well and is good to eat as it is.

en_US: Fish rubbed with Salt and dried for 2 days on a Drying Rack. Salty and filling.
zh_TW: 抹了鹽的魚在曬魚架上曬 2 天。鹹香耐飽。
zh_CN: 抹了盐的鱼在晒鱼架上晒 2 天。咸香耐饱。

mechanics: Fish rubbed with Salt and dried for 2 days on a Drying Rack. Salty and filling.

en_US: Squid dried for 2 days on a Drying Rack. A chewy snack.
zh_TW: 魷魚在曬魚架上曬 2 天。越嚼越香的零嘴。
zh_CN: 鱿鱼在晒鱼架上晒 2 天。越嚼越香的零嘴。

mechanics: Squid dried for 2 days on a Drying Rack. A chewy snack.

en_US: Skipjack dried for 3 days on a Drying Rack, hard as wood. Shave it on Cookery's Chopping Board for Bonito Flakes.
zh_TW: 鰹魚在曬魚架上曬 3 天，硬得像木頭。放到本體的砧板上削成柴魚片。
zh_CN: 鲣鱼在晒鱼架上晒 3 天，硬得像木头。放到本体的砧板上削成柴鱼片。

mechanics: Skipjack dried for 3 days on a Drying Rack, hard as wood. Shave it on Cookery's Chopping Board for Bonito Flakes.

en_US: Shaved from Katsuobushi on the Chopping Board (4 each). Boils into Fish Stock.
zh_TW: 柴魚在砧板上削出來（每塊 4 份）。可以熬魚高湯。
zh_CN: 柴鱼在砧板上削出来（每块 4 份）。可以熬鱼高汤。

mechanics: Shaved from Katsuobushi on the Chopping Board (4 each). Boils into Fish Stock.

en_US: Under the ice: fish through an Ice Hole or any gap in a frozen lake or sea. The most common ice fish, small and silvery.
zh_TW: 冰面底下：在冰洞或結冰湖海的缺口釣。最常見的冰下魚，小小一條銀亮亮的。
zh_CN: 冰面底下：在冰洞或结冰湖海的缺口钓。最常见的冰下鱼，小小一条银亮亮的。

mechanics: Under the ice: fish through an Ice Hole or any gap in a frozen lake or sea. The most common ice fish, small and silvery.

en_US: Under the ice (Ice Hole). A pink stripe down its side; puts up a fair fight.
zh_TW: 冰面底下（冰洞）。身側有一道粉紅色條紋，拉扯有點力道。
zh_CN: 冰面底下（冰洞）。身侧有一道粉红色条纹，拉扯有点力道。

mechanics: Under the ice (Ice Hole). A pink stripe down its side; puts up a fair fight.

en_US: Under the ice (Ice Hole), less common, bites most at dawn and dusk. Orange belly, pale spots, a long fight.
zh_TW: 冰面底下（冰洞），比較少見，清晨黃昏最常上鉤。橘紅色的肚子、淡色斑點，拉扯很久。
zh_CN: 冰面底下（冰洞），比较少见，清晨黄昏最常上钩。橘红色的肚子、淡色斑点，拉扯很久。

mechanics: Under the ice (Ice Hole), less common, bites most at dawn and dusk. Orange belly, pale spots, a long fight.

en_US: Use it on Ice or Packed Ice with water underneath to drill an Ice Hole. The hole does not freeze over; fish through it with any rod, or set a Tip-up in it.
zh_TW: 對著底下有水的冰或浮冰使用，鑽出一個冰洞。冰洞不會再結凍，可以拿任何釣竿往裡面釣，或放一支插旗浮標。
zh_CN: 对着底下有水的冰或浮冰使用，钻出一个冰洞。冰洞不会再结冻，可以拿任何钓竿往里面钓，或放一支插旗浮标。

mechanics: Use it on Ice or Packed Ice with water underneath to drill an Ice Hole. The hole does not freeze over; fish through it with any rod, or set a Tip-up in it.

en_US: Set it in an Ice Hole and it fishes for you, slowly: when a fish bites the red flag springs up and a bell rings. Go and use the hole to take the fish before it gets away. Small and medium fish only; up to 3 per player. Use an empty hand on it to take it back.
zh_TW: 放進冰洞就會自己慢慢釣：魚咬鉤時小紅旗彈起、鈴聲響。過去使用冰洞把魚收起來，太慢魚會跑掉。只釣得到小型和中型的魚，每人最多同時放 3 支。空手使用可以收回。
zh_CN: 放进冰洞就会自己慢慢钓：鱼咬钩时小红旗弹起、铃声响。过去使用冰洞把鱼收起来，太慢鱼会跑掉。只钓得到小型和中型的鱼，每人最多同时放 3 支。空手使用可以收回。

mechanics: Set it in an Ice Hole and it fishes for you, slowly: when a fish bites the red flag springs up and a bell rings. Go and use the hole to take the fish before it gets away. Small and medium fish only; up to 3 per player. Use an empty hand on it to take it back.

en_US: Boil two Bonito Flakes with Kelp in the Stockpot (water) and take it out with a bucket. Pour it into a Stockpot as a soup base for Oden and Arctic Char Rice.
zh_TW: 湯鍋（清水）放兩份柴魚片和海帶熬好，用桶子舀起來。倒進湯鍋當湯底，可以煮關東煮和紅點鮭炊飯。
zh_CN: 汤锅（清水）放两份柴鱼片和海带熬好，用桶子舀起来。倒进汤锅当汤底，可以煮关东煮和红点鲑炊饭。

mechanics: Boil two Bonito Flakes with Kelp in the Stockpot (water) and take it out with a bucket. Pour it into a Stockpot as a soup base for Oden and Arctic Char Rice.

en_US: A pot of oden on a little stove, four bites; you get the cauldron back.
zh_TW: 小爐上的一鍋關東煮，分四口吃，吃完退回鍋釜。
zh_CN: 小炉上的一锅关东煮，分四口吃，吃完退回炼药锅。

mechanics: A pot of oden on a little stove, four bites; you get the cauldron back.

en_US: A 1x2 board of the ice catch: smelt tempura on one block, pan-fried trout on the other, on crushed ice. Each block is eaten in three bites.
zh_TW: 1×2 的木板，盛著冰釣的漁獲：一格公魚天婦羅、一格香煎虹鱒，墊著碎冰。每格分三口吃。
zh_CN: 1×2 的木板，盛着冰钓的渔获：一格公鱼天妇罗、一格香煎虹鳟，垫着碎冰。每格分三口吃。

mechanics: A 1x2 board of the ice catch: smelt tempura on one block, pan-fried trout on the other, on crushed ice. Each block is eaten in three bites.

en_US: Hang a Voyage Fishing Rod on a Tackle Rack and use an Eye of Ender on it: it becomes an Ender Fishing Rod, keeping its wear, enchantments and parts. Fishes like the Voyage rod in water, and also over the End's void: stand at the edge of an End island and cast out into the dark. The bobber hangs in the air; what you land drops at your feet.
zh_TW: 把漁歌釣竿掛在漁具架上，拿末影之眼對它使用，就會變成末影釣竿，耐久、附魔和部件都保留。在水裡用法同漁歌釣竿，也能在末地往虛空釣魚：站在末地島邊緣往黑暗裡拋竿，浮標會懸在半空，釣到的東西落在腳邊。
zh_CN: 把渔歌钓竿挂在渔具架上，拿末影之眼对它使用，就会变成末影钓竿，耐久、附魔和部件都保留。在水里用法同渔歌钓竿，也能在末地往虚空钓鱼：站在末地岛边缘往黑暗里抛竿，浮标会悬在半空，钓到的东西落在脚边。

mechanics: Hang a Voyage Fishing Rod on a Tackle Rack and use an Eye of Ender on it: it becomes an Ender Fishing Rod, keeping its wear, enchantments and parts. Fishes like the Voyage rod in water, and also over the End's void: stand at the edge of an End island and cast out into the dark. The bobber hangs in the air; what you land drops at your feet.

en_US: The End's void, with the Ender Fishing Rod. The most common void catch. Eating it slows your fall for a while.
zh_TW: 末地的虛空，需要末影釣竿。最常見的虛空漁獲。吃了會緩降一陣子。
zh_CN: 末地的虚空，需要末影钓竿。最常见的虚空渔获。吃了会缓降一阵子。

mechanics: The End's void, with the Ender Fishing Rod. The most common void catch. Eating it slows your fall for a while.

en_US: The End's void, with the Ender Fishing Rod. A pale purple shrimp.
zh_TW: 末地的虛空，需要末影釣竿。淡紫色的蝦。
zh_CN: 末地的虚空，需要末影钓竿。淡紫色的虾。

mechanics: The End's void, with the Ender Fishing Rod. A pale purple shrimp.

en_US: Rare, deep in the void (Ender Fishing Rod): the bait has to hang deep, so fit a Weighted Bobber. A long fight. Slow falling and night vision.
zh_TW: 稀有，在虛空深處（末影釣竿）：餌要垂得夠深，得裝上重墜浮標。拉扯很久。吃了緩降又有夜視。
zh_CN: 稀有，在虚空深处（末影钓竿）：饵要垂得够深，得装上重坠浮标。拉扯很久。吃了缓降又有夜视。

mechanics: Rare, deep in the void (Ender Fishing Rod): the bait has to hang deep, so fit a Weighted Bobber. A long fight. Slow falling and night vision.

en_US: Open sea, only at dawn and dusk. Rare: a croaker scaled in gold.
zh_TW: 開闊的海，只在清晨和黃昏。稀有，鱗片像金子一樣的黃魚。
zh_CN: 开阔的海，只在清晨和黄昏。稀有，鳞片像金子一样的黄鱼。

mechanics: Open sea, only at dawn and dusk. Rare: a croaker scaled in gold.

en_US: Open and deep sea, only on full-moon nights. Craft one into four Glow Bait.
zh_TW: 開闊的海與深海，只在滿月的夜晚。一隻可以做成四個螢光魚餌。
zh_CN: 开阔的海与深海，只在满月的夜晚。一只可以做成四个荧光鱼饵。

mechanics: Open and deep sea, only on full-moon nights. Craft one into four Glow Bait.

en_US: Beaches, only on full-moon nights (up to 4 blocks deep). Steam it like any crab.
zh_TW: 海灘，只在滿月的夜晚（水深 4 格內）。可以像一般螃蟹一樣清蒸。
zh_CN: 海滩，只在满月的夜晚（水深 4 格内）。可以像一般螃蟹一样清蒸。

mechanics: Beaches, only on full-moon nights (up to 4 blocks deep). Steam it like any crab.

en_US: Any water in the End, with any rod. The most common End pond catch.
zh_TW: 末地裡的任何水，任何釣竿都能釣。末地水池最常見的漁獲。
zh_CN: 末地里的任何水，任何钓竿都能钓。末地水池最常见的渔获。

mechanics: Any water in the End, with any rod. The most common End pond catch.

en_US: Any water in the End. Goes into Void Seafood Soup.
zh_TW: 末地裡的任何水。虛空海鮮湯的食材。
zh_CN: 末地里的任何水。虚空海鲜汤的食材。

mechanics: Any water in the End. Goes into Void Seafood Soup.

en_US: Any water in the End, rare. Ender Maggot Bait draws it in. Fights hard; cut it up for Ender Pearls.
zh_TW: 末地裡的任何水，稀有。用末影蟲餌比較容易上鉤。拉扯很久，切開可以拿到末影珍珠。
zh_CN: 末地里的任何水，稀有。用末影虫饵比较容易上钩。拉扯很久，切开可以拿到末影珍珠。

mechanics: Any water in the End, rare. Ender Maggot Bait draws it in. Fights hard; cut it up for Ender Pearls.

en_US: Eating it blinks you to solid ground nearby, like a chorus fruit.
zh_TW: 吃了會像歌萊果一樣，瞬移到附近的實地上。
zh_CN: 吃了会像紫颂果一样，瞬移到附近的实地上。

mechanics: Eating it blinks you to solid ground nearby, like a chorus fruit.

en_US: Slow Falling for a minute.
zh_TW: 緩降一分鐘。
zh_CN: 缓降一分钟。

mechanics: Slow Falling for a minute.

en_US: Bait for End ponds. Keep it in your inventory: bites come sooner, and the Ender Angler comes to it.
zh_TW: 末地水池用的餌。放在背包：魚上鉤更快，末影鮟鱇特別喜歡。
zh_CN: 末地水池用的饵。放在背包：鱼上钩更快，末影鮟鱇特别喜欢。

mechanics: Bait for End ponds. Keep it in your inventory: bites come sooner, and the Ender Angler comes to it.

en_US: River mouths where fresh water meets the sea. Bites best at dawn and dusk.
zh_TW: 河口：河水與海水交會處。清晨與黃昏最常上鉤。
zh_CN: 河口：河水与海水交会处。清晨与黄昏最常上钩。

mechanics: River mouths where fresh water meets the sea. Bites best at dawn and dusk.

en_US: River mouths and beaches. The mullet run comes on new-moon nights.
zh_TW: 河口與海灘。新月的夜晚是烏魚汛，成群上鉤。
zh_CN: 河口与海滩。新月的夜晚是乌鱼汛，成群上钩。

mechanics: River mouths and beaches. The mullet run comes on new-moon nights.

en_US: Shallow swamp and mangrove water at night, more in the rain.
zh_TW: 沼澤與紅樹林的淺水，夜晚；下雨更多。
zh_CN: 沼泽与红树林的浅水，夜晚；下雨更多。

mechanics: Shallow swamp and mangrove water at night, more in the rain.

en_US: Swamps and still lakes in the daytime. A strong, stubborn fish.
zh_TW: 沼澤與靜水湖泊的白天。力氣大、很倔。
zh_CN: 沼泽与静水湖泊的白天。力气大、很倔。

mechanics: Swamps and still lakes in the daytime. A strong, stubborn fish.

en_US: Mangrove mudflats, in water no deeper than 2 blocks. Twice as many at low tide.
zh_TW: 紅樹林的泥灘，水深 2 格內。退潮時多一倍。
zh_CN: 红树林的泥滩，水深 2 格内。退潮时多一倍。

mechanics: Mangrove mudflats, in water no deeper than 2 blocks. Twice as many at low tide.

en_US: Open and warm seas in the daytime; a fish school brings them in threes. Full-moon days are the season.
zh_TW: 開闊與溫暖海域的白天；魚群裡特別多。滿月的白天是飛魚季。
zh_CN: 开阔与温暖海域的白天；鱼群里特别多。满月的白天是飞鱼季。

mechanics: Open and warm seas in the daytime; a fish school brings them in threes. Full-moon days are the season.

en_US: Rocky shallows at night, more at low tide. It fights for a lobster.
zh_TW: 夜晚的淺海礁岩，退潮更多。會掙扎。
zh_CN: 夜晚的浅海礁岩，退潮更多。会挣扎。

mechanics: Rocky shallows at night, more at low tide. It fights for a lobster.

en_US: Cold, deep seas (8 blocks or more). Needs the Voyage Fishing Rod. Heavy on the line.
zh_TW: 寒冷的深海（至少 8 格深）。需要漁歌釣竿。線會很沉。
zh_CN: 寒冷的深海（至少 8 格深）。需要渔歌钓竿。线会很沉。

mechanics: Cold, deep seas (8 blocks or more). Needs the Voyage Fishing Rod. Heavy on the line.

en_US: Underground water with no sky above it, below Y 48. Pale and eyeless.
zh_TW: 地底、頭頂沒有天空的水域（Y 48 以下）。蒼白、沒有眼睛。
zh_CN: 地底、头顶没有天空的水域（Y 48 以下）。苍白、没有眼睛。

mechanics: Underground water with no sky above it, below Y 48. Pale and eyeless.

en_US: Lush cave pools, among moss and glow berries.
zh_TW: 繁茂洞穴的水池，苔蘚與發光漿果之間。
zh_CN: 繁茂洞穴的水池，苔藓与发光浆果之间。

mechanics: Lush cave pools, among moss and glow berries.

en_US: Cut from a flying fish on the chopping board.
zh_TW: 在砧板上剖飛魚取得。
zh_CN: 在砧板上剖飞鱼取得。

mechanics: Cut from a flying fish on the chopping board.

en_US: Tackle part (hook). A feathered lure: the rod fishes without bait and the lure is never used up, though rare fish come a little less often.
zh_TW: 釣具部件（鉤）。羽毛假餌：不用餌也能釣，假餌不會消耗；稀有魚稍微少一點。
zh_CN: 钓具部件（钩）。羽毛假饵：不用饵也能钓，假饵不会消耗；稀有鱼稍微少一点。

mechanics: Tackle part (hook). A feathered lure: the rod fishes without bait and the lure is never used up, though rare fish come a little less often.

en_US: Tackle part (line). A faintly green line: at night, bites come sooner.
zh_TW: 釣具部件（線）。淡綠色的線：夜晚咬鉤更快。
zh_CN: 钓具部件（线）。淡绿色的线：夜晚咬钩更快。

mechanics: Tackle part (line). A faintly green line: at night, bites come sooner.

en_US: Tackle part (bobber). Rides high: the bait stays shallow, and shallow-water catches (shrimp, crabs, loach, lobster) come more often.
zh_TW: 釣具部件（浮標）。浮得高：餌留在淺處，淺水漁獲（蝦、蟹、泥鰍、龍蝦）更常上鉤。
zh_CN: 钓具部件（浮标）。浮得高：饵留在浅处，浅水渔获（虾、蟹、泥鳅、龙虾）更常上钩。

mechanics: Tackle part (bobber). Rides high: the bait stays shallow, and shallow-water catches (shrimp, crabs, loach, lobster) come more often.

en_US: Bait. Some of the shrimp taken from a Shrimp Trap are still alive. Sea bass and lobster love it.
zh_TW: 魚餌。從蝦籠取出的蝦有些還活著。鱸魚和龍蝦特別愛。
zh_CN: 鱼饵。从虾笼取出的虾有些还活着。鲈鱼和龙虾特别爱。

mechanics: Bait. Some of the shrimp taken from a Shrimp Trap are still alive. Sea bass and lobster love it.

en_US: Bait. Dig grass or dirt with a shovel in the rain and one sometimes wriggles out. Fresh-water fish and loach take it well.
zh_TW: 魚餌。下雨時用鏟子挖草地或泥土，偶爾會挖到。淡水魚和泥鰍很愛。
zh_CN: 鱼饵。下雨时用铲子挖草地或泥土，偶尔会挖到。淡水鱼和泥鳅很爱。

mechanics: Bait. Dig grass or dirt with a shovel in the rain and one sometimes wriggles out. Fresh-water fish and loach take it well.

en_US: Cut from a grey mullet on the chopping board. Salt it, then hang it on a Drying Rack for karasumi.
zh_TW: 在砧板上剖烏魚取得。抹鹽後掛上曬魚架，就會曬成烏魚子。
zh_CN: 在砧板上剖乌鱼取得。抹盐后挂上晒鱼架，就会晒成乌鱼子。

mechanics: Cut from a grey mullet on the chopping board. Salt it, then hang it on a Drying Rack for karasumi.

en_US: Hang it on a Drying Rack: in 3 days it turns into karasumi, amber and firm.
zh_TW: 掛上曬魚架，3 天後曬成琥珀色、結實的烏魚子。
zh_CN: 挂上晒鱼架，3 天后晒成琥珀色、结实的乌鱼子。

mechanics: Hang it on a Drying Rack: in 3 days it turns into karasumi, amber and firm.

en_US: Salted mullet roe dried for 3 days on a Drying Rack. Slice it on the chopping board.
zh_TW: 鹽漬烏魚卵在曬魚架上曬 3 天。放到砧板上切片。
zh_CN: 盐渍乌鱼卵在晒鱼架上晒 3 天。放到砧板上切片。

mechanics: Salted mullet roe dried for 3 days on a Drying Rack. Slice it on the chopping board.

en_US: A flying fish dried overnight on a Drying Rack. Grill it.
zh_TW: 飛魚在曬魚架上曬一夜。拿去烤。
zh_CN: 飞鱼在晒鱼架上晒一夜。拿去烤。

mechanics: A flying fish dried overnight on a Drying Rack. Grill it.

en_US: Drawn with a glass bottle from a Fish Sauce Jar of salted small fish. Works in place of salt in every wok dish.
zh_TW: 用玻璃瓶從醃小魚的魚露甕取得。所有炒鍋料理都可以拿它代替鹽。
zh_CN: 用玻璃瓶从腌小鱼的鱼露瓮取得。所有炒锅料理都可以拿它代替盐。

mechanics: Drawn with a glass bottle from a Fish Sauce Jar of salted small fish. Works in place of salt in every wok dish.

en_US: Scooped with a bowl from a Fish Sauce Jar of salted dried shrimp.
zh_TW: 用碗從醃蝦米的魚露甕舀出。
zh_CN: 用碗从腌虾米的鱼露瓮舀出。

mechanics: Scooped with a bowl from a Fish Sauce Jar of salted dried shrimp.

en_US: Rub in Salt first, then add 4 small fish (fish sauce) or 4 Dried Shrimp (shrimp paste). It seals itself and ferments; when the lid is off, draw fish sauce with glass bottles or scoop shrimp paste with bowls: 4 each.
zh_TW: 先放鹽，再放 4 條小魚（魚露）或 4 份蝦米（蝦醬）。甕會自己封起來發酵；蓋子打開後用玻璃瓶取魚露、用碗舀蝦醬，各 4 份。
zh_CN: 先放盐，再放 4 条小鱼（鱼露）或 4 份虾米（虾酱）。瓮会自己封起来发酵；盖子打开后用玻璃瓶取鱼露、用碗舀虾酱，各 4 份。

mechanics: Rub in Salt first, then add 4 small fish (fish sauce) or 4 Dried Shrimp (shrimp paste). It seals itself and ferments; when the lid is off, draw fish sauce with glass bottles or scoop shrimp paste with bowls: 4 each.

en_US: A river or swamp on a thunderstorm night. Only a Voyage rod with a Bone Hook holds it.
zh_TW: 雷雨夜的河流或沼澤。只有裝了骨鉤的漁歌釣竿拉得住。
zh_CN: 雷雨夜的河流或沼泽。只有装了骨钩的渔歌钓竿拉得住。

mechanics: A river or swamp on a thunderstorm night. Only a Voyage rod with a Bone Hook holds it.

en_US: Deep sea (12 blocks or more) at high tide, under a full moon, in the rain. It wants live shrimp.
zh_TW: 深海（至少 12 格），滿月、漲潮、下雨時。牠只吃活蝦。
zh_CN: 深海（至少 12 格），满月、涨潮、下雨时。它只吃活虾。

mechanics: Deep sea (12 blocks or more) at high tide, under a full moon, in the rain. It wants live shrimp.

en_US: Under the ice at dawn after a new moon. A tip-up will never take it; fish for it by hand.
zh_TW: 新月後的清晨，冰面底下。插旗浮標釣不到，要親手釣。
zh_CN: 新月后的清晨，冰面底下。插旗浮标钓不到，要亲手钓。

mechanics: Under the ice at dawn after a new moon. A tip-up will never take it; fish for it by hand.

en_US: Nether lava at least 4 blocks deep, on a Lava rod with a Wire Line and no bait: it only strikes a bare hook or a lure.
zh_TW: 下界至少 4 格深的岩漿，熔岩釣竿配鋼絲線、不掛餌：牠只咬空鉤或假餌。
zh_CN: 下界至少 4 格深的岩浆，熔岩钓竿配钢丝线、不挂饵：它只咬空钩或假饵。

mechanics: Nether lava at least 4 blocks deep, on a Lava rod with a Wire Line and no bait: it only strikes a bare hook or a lure.

en_US: A whisker as long as your arm, from the River Lord Catfish. A keepsake.
zh_TW: 河伯鯰的鬚，比手臂還長。紀念品。
zh_CN: 河伯鲶的须，比手臂还长。纪念品。

mechanics: A whisker as long as your arm, from the River Lord Catfish. A keepsake.

en_US: A scale from the Lava Dragon Koi, still warm. A keepsake.
zh_TW: 熔岩龍鯉的鱗，還是溫的。紀念品。
zh_CN: 熔岩龙鲤的鳞，还是温的。纪念品。

mechanics: A scale from the Lava Dragon Koi, still warm. A keepsake.

en_US: The Emperor Bluefin laid out whole, royal blue and gold. Place it and carve it like a Whole Tuna.
zh_TW: 整尾藍鰭皇鮪，寶藍帶金。放下後跟鮪魚大體一樣切來吃。
zh_CN: 整尾蓝鳍皇鲔，宝蓝带金。放下后跟鲔鱼大体一样切来吃。

mechanics: The Emperor Bluefin laid out whole, royal blue and gold. Place it and carve it like a Whole Tuna.

en_US: The Frostlake Char served on frosted ice with the ice-fishing catch. Place it and share it.
zh_TW: 冰湖主配上冰釣漁獲，鋪在結霜的冰上。放下來大家一起吃。
zh_CN: 冰湖主配上冰钓渔获，铺在结霜的冰上。放下来大家一起吃。

mechanics: The Frostlake Char served on frosted ice with the ice-fishing catch. Place it and share it.

en_US.title: Fishing Voyage
en_US.intro: Fish, shellfish and seafood dishes from rivers, swamps and seas. Catch fish with the Bamboo Fishing Rod, then prepare them at Cookery stations.
en_US.language_note: This section follows the guidebook language setting.

zh_TW.title: 森羅物語：漁歌
zh_TW.intro: 河流、沼澤與海洋的漁獲和海鮮料理。用竹釣竿釣魚，再到森羅物語的烹飪站點處理。
zh_TW.language_note: 本分頁跟隨圖鑑書的語言設定。

zh_CN.title: 森罗物语：渔歌
zh_CN.intro: 河流、沼泽与海洋的渔获和海鲜料理。用竹钓竿钓鱼，再到森罗物语的烹饪站点处理。
zh_CN.language_note: 本分页跟随图鉴书的语言设置。
